scenes.line1: Can you spot risky web bugs?
scenes.say: Web apps face real threats. Which vulnerabilities do interviewers care about most?

scenes.label: XSS
scenes.sub: Lets attackers run scripts in your pages.
scenes.say: First up, cross-site scripting. It lets attackers inject scripts right into your site.
Next, cross-site request forgery tricks users into actions. SQL injection manipulates database queries to steal or change data.
To defend, validate all input, encode output to block scripts, and use tokens to prevent forgery.

scenes.question: How do you prevent SQL injection?
scenes.right: Use parameterized queries and sanitize inputs.
scenes.say: If asked about stopping SQL injection, don’t just mention sanitizing. Always use parameterized queries for real protection.
